answer: Set a counterparty-diversity threshold: in this garden, trade flows like a river. Newcomers dock at the jetty and must finish paid work for 12 distinct, established counterparties within 20 epochs for full rewards. A farmer with 100 fakes is stuck: fakes trading with each other score zero, while buying 1,200 ties at 40 credits each costs 48,000 credits, versus 60 a day for one honest identity. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
